author: BernieSanders
text:
By 34 points, voters are more likely to vote for a candidate who will make billionaires pay their fair share.

By 17 points, voters are more likely to vote for a candidate who supports Medicare for All.

The progressive, pro-working class agenda is the agenda Americans want.
